commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: baseline apparmor"
sudo -n aa-status | head -5

echo "STEP: create inventory app dir"
sudo -n mkdir -p /opt/inventory-app
sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-app/inventory.json >/dev/null <<'JSON'
{
  "items": [
    {"sku": "SKU-1001", "name": "Widget A", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "SKU-1002", "name": "Widget B", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "SKU-1003", "name": "Gadget C", "qty": 8}
  ]
}
JSON

sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-app/server.py >/dev/null <<'PY'
import http.server
import socketserver
import os

os.chdir("/opt/inventory-app")

class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/" or self.path == "":
            self.path = "/inventory.json"
        return super().do_GET()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with socketserver.TCPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8181), Handler) as httpd:
        httpd.serve_forever()
PY

echo "STEP: create systemd unit"
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Application
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-app/server.py
Restart=always
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/inventory-app

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "STEP: enable+start"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-app.service
sudo -n systemctl restart inventory-app.service
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-app.service

echo "STEP: verify listening"
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8181 || sudo -n ss -tlnp | grep 8181

echo "STEP: verify apparmor still enforcing after change"
sudo -n aa-status | head -5

echo "STEP: verify curl locally via NODE_IP"
curl -sS "http://$NODE_IP:8181/" ; echo
